title: Vault of Nightmares
description: A large metallic vault door stands open on a cracked black-and-white checkered floor, revealing a terrified woman in a suit and aviator cap stepping through into a bleak landscape. Golden snake chess pieces are scattered across the foreground while a swarm of screaming ghostly faces and a fiery comet fill the dark sky above.
prompt: Surreal dark scene featuring a massive circular metallic vault door cracked open on a broken black and white checkered floor. Golden cobra chess pieces are scattered and standing on the tiles. A woman wearing an aviator cap and dark suit is stepping out from inside the vault into a desolate landscape. Above the vault, a chaotic swarm of terrified screaming ghostly faces and a bright yellow fiery comet streak across a black sky. Cracked picture frames and vines on the ground, dramatic lighting, intricate linework.
